name: claude-delegate
tagline_zh: 让另一个 Claude 替你写代码，你只审 diff 再合并。适合多任务并行或想甩锅给分身时。
tagline_en: Hand off coding to a separate Claude, review the diff, and merge. Perfect for parallel tasks or offloading—even.
desc_en: Delegate a coding task to a separate Claude Code CLI process or another Claude session as an implementer, then review its diff and land it yourself. Use only when the user explicitly asks to delegate implementation to Claude Code, another Claude session, or the `claude` CLI — for example, "have another Claude implement this", "delegate this to Claude Code", or "run this queue through a separate Cl
why_zh: 同类工具多只做单线程对话，它却真能拉起独立 CLI 进程干活，你只把关 diff，分工清晰不越权。
why_en: Unlike chat-only tools, it spawns real CLI processes for delegated work, letting you review diffs without losing control.
